title: BAEnchants
body:
A simple datapack that adds enchantment name in game "Blue Archive".

**no actual function provided.**

see:[BlueArchiveTypes](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bluearchive-types) for full implmentation

main purpose to upload this is to be dependency of other projects，you can also create plugins or something else according to this.

只是一个增加了游戏《Blue Archive》中的攻击属性与防御属性名称的附魔的简单数据包，**没有实质功能**

可以查看[BlueArchiveTypes](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bluearchive-types)这个项目，来实现这些附魔的具体功能

主要目的是作为其他项目的依赖，你也可以自己根据附魔来编写插件
